manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the top of a vertical toss, velocity is zero for an instant, but gravity keeps pulling with acceleration g. A second ball released at that exact moment falls identically.
manifest.description: Two vertical lanes show a tossed ball on the left and a dropped ball on the right. Velocity and acceleration vectors accompany each ball alongside live readouts.
assumptions: No air resistance, constant gravity, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. Pause at the top to compare velocity and acceleration.
